hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the family F(n; g) = K(n)*g(n) where g is a placeholder for a function of n. Each target expression is obtained by specializing g to the corresponding function: set g = a(n) for the first term and g = b(n) for the second term.
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), b(n) are well-defined functions of n
The placeholder g can be replaced by any function, including a(n) and b(n)
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the identical prefactor K(n) and differ only in the second factor. This is precisely the structure of a family of functions parameterized by the second factor, with K(n) as the common kernel.
